steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There are much more monsters now than when Hamel was here, and they're wilder too. The Corruptors that awakened have also mixed in. And...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is BR-004 all over again. We won't be able to kill them off. It's just a fool's errand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh... This is a parade. So... can't they just do a bit of pushing and shoving and call it a day?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We can't fight like this forever. We'll go mad. If we aren't already dead because of exhaustion by then, that is.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Avoid engaging the monsters. Save your strength for the real enemy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Go to the Ferris wheel and locate Phantom Hamel. Defeating her is the only way to get rid of the Black Ring.
You hear a voice pipe up right beside your ear. You turn your head and see a dark figure looming over you.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Hehe, I want to see you too.
